title: Two defaults
prompt: The robot's standard plot is 4 by 3, and area_with_defaults gives the area of a plot: both sizes have defaults, so the tests call it with no values, one value and two. area_with_defaults() is 12.
hints: Width times height. With one value passed, only the first parameter changes; the second keeps its default.
solution:
func area_with_defaults(width = 4, height = 3):
	return width * height
